items.summary_en: Ponytail is an open-source project that pushes AI coding agents to behave like the 'laziest senior dev'—write only the minimum, and one line if that's enough. It's published as the npm package @dietrichgebert/ponytail and the README badge claims compatibility with 20 agents. Useful for developers who want AI to write less, not more.

items.summary_zh: Snowflake 发布《GTM 领导者 AI 转型蓝图》，记录了自家销售与营销团队如何在客户全生命周期中用 AI 推动营收增长。其核心发现是瓶颈不在技术而在组织：两个部门优化不同目标、依赖不同数据，AI 只是让这种割裂更明显，因此需要先打通共享数据与跨团队流程，单点效率提升才可能转化为销售管道。
items.summary_en: Snowflake has published The GTM Leader's Blueprint for AI Transformation, documenting how its own sales and marketing teams apply AI across the customer lifecycle to drive revenue. Its main finding is that the bottleneck is organizational rather than technical: the two functions optimize different goals and rely on different data, so AI only makes the split more visible. Shared data and redesigned cross-team workflows are needed before local productivity gains turn into pipeline.

items.summary_en: The author describes using AI to take over a park-building 3D dashboard project that would normally go to an outside team, covering Revit/IFC model handling, web asset and LOD optimization, a Three.js scene, floor-component interactions, and finally embedding it into a Vue dashboard via iframe. It lays out a full path from raw model to front-end integration, useful for front-end developers building 3D visualization dashboards who want to judge whether AI can replace outsourced work.
